items.headline: United beat Rosenborg 5-0 in pre-season friendly
items.summary: Michael Carrick's side defeated Rosenborg in Trondheim with goals including Shea Lacey's opener and Joshua Zirkzee's contribution.

items.headline: Sesko recovery progressing ahead of season
items.summary: Benjamin Sesko is reported as "getting there" with his recovery from injury ahead of the 2026-27 campaign.

items.headline: Manchester United confirm Women's signing Leitzig
items.summary: Manchester United Women have completed the transfer of a player named Leitzig.

items.headline: United reveal new 2026-27 away kit design
items.summary: Manchester United unveiled their new away kit for next season inspired by rare design elements.

items.headline: Carrick finalizes permanent manager contract
items.summary: Michael Carrick confirmed as permanent Manchester United manager after leading club to Champions League qualification.
